name: live-cursors
title: Live cursors
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Cursors and name labels positioned inside a relative container. Pointer updates are container-relative and throttled with requestAnimationFrame.

meta.descriptionEs: Cursores con nombre, en coordenadas del contenedor. Sin deslizamiento si se prefiere menos movimiento.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cero, uno y muchos cursores en 320px.

meta.usage: const ref = useRef(null) useContainerCursor(ref)

api.name: LiveCursors
api.description: Renders other users' presence.cursor with a name label.

api.name: useContainerCursor
api.description: Writes container-relative coordinates, throttled with requestAnimationFrame.

docs: Requires PresenceProvider and presence.cursor. Reduced motion snaps to the latest point instead of smoothing. The layer is aria-hidden because positions change continuously; names are on the avatar stack.
